$comment: Machine-readable brand tokens for the lantern mobile client. Source of truth is docs/lantern-brand-sheet.svg; every hex here appears verbatim in that file. Consumed by the future Android Compose theme (src/mobile/app). Human guidance and provenance: docs/brand-guidelines.md.

brand.name: lantern
brand.descriptor: A mobile companion for Microsoft Scout
brand.productOf: Microsoft Scout companion (nominative use; verify against Microsoft trademark guidelines)

candle.role: brand accent, primary emphasis, lantern flame

status.$comment: Semantic agent/command status. Defined by the brand sheet PALETTE row.

support.$comment: Structural tints read from the sheet artwork; present but not formally named on the sheet. Kept here so the theme has a single source.

iconography.mark: lantern (arched handle, rounded body, inner flame pane)
iconography.principle: The pane is the status: the inner flame is recolored to the semantic status token. Offline desaturates the whole mark to color.status.offline / color.support.flameMuted.
